constraints.constraint: Show the front of the school buses
constraints.A_evidence: Several yellow school buses are visibly shown from the front, including the large foreground bus.
constraints.B_evidence: Multiple yellow school buses are clearly shown from the front, especially the prominent center bus and the buses at the sides.

constraints.constraint: Park the school buses adjacent to each other
constraints.A_evidence: The buses appear parked in the same lot, but most are arranged behind one another rather than clearly side by side.
constraints.B_evidence: Several buses are visibly clustered and parked directly beside one another, forming an adjacent group.

judgment.reason: Both candidates clearly show the fronts of school buses, but B more directly preserves the requested adjacent parking arrangement; A primarily shows buses lined up behind one another.
